zh: 三月之前，月下一劍，血蓮魔尊墜落雲海。
然而江湖的風雨，從來不會因為一個人的死而停歇。
凌大俠，這卷劍譜……真要交給三教嗎？
它在妳身上一天，妳就一天不得安寧。
龍淵閣的三教大會，會給它一個去處。
我只怕，三教之中，也有想要它的人。
錢不二。你在這裡做什麼？
做什麼？當然是做生意啊！兩位要去龍淵閣，對不對？
我勸兩位別去……除非，給我十兩銀子，我告訴你們為什麼。
嘿嘿，爽快！因為——去的人，不一定回得來！
錢不二的消息，從來不是白賣的。走吧。
龍淵閣。儒門之首殷九霄，召集三教，共議天劍譜的去留。
白鶴道長，慧明小師父，兩位遠道而來，九霄有禮了。
家師無涯閉關未出，命小僧代為列席，請閣主見諒。
哈哈，殷兄的酒，貧道可是三年前就惦記上了！
道長放心，今夜的酒，管夠。
凌少俠、燕姑娘，一路辛苦。劍譜……可帶來了？
帶來了。但我要先聽聽，三教打算怎麼處置它。
劍譜事關天下，流落江湖，只會引來更多的血。
九霄的意思，不如由龍淵閣代為保管，三教共守。
保管保管，保著保著，就保成自己的了。哈哈哈！
三教議事？議來議去，不過是誰的拳頭硬，誰說了算！
魏無憂。龍淵閣，似乎沒有發帖子給你。
我魏無憂去哪裡，從來不需要帖子。
凌雲霄，聽說你一劍擊落了血蓮魔尊？我不信。
那就讓我的刀，來問問你的劍！
好了好了！在龍淵閣動刀，你叫殷兄的面子往哪兒擺？
諸位都是為了天下，何必傷了和氣。
洛無塵！你這隻閒雲野鶴，居然也肯出山？
天下的熱鬧都在這裡，無塵豈能錯過。
洛先生大駕光臨，龍淵閣蓬蓽生輝。不知先生對劍譜，有何高見？
高見不敢。劍譜，不該歸任何一人，也不該歸任何一門。
三教各出一道封印，共封於萬佛峰。誰也拿不走，誰也不必猜忌誰。
阿彌陀佛。洛先生此言，正合家師之意。
好！貧道也贊成。殷兄，你說呢？
既然如此，便以酒為誓。來，諸位滿飲此杯！
一杯酒，從燕飛霜的席上傳到了慧明手中。
小僧以茶代酒……不，今日破例，就飲這一杯。
有毒！這杯酒……是從燕姑娘的席上傳過來的！
慧明小師父代表萬佛峰。他死在這裡，我們如何向無涯佛者交代？拿下她！
無塵不攔你。只是，人死了，總要先看看他是怎麼死的。
凌少俠，去追燕姑娘吧。今夜，她比你更需要你的劍。
洛先生，你這是在包庇兇手？
殷閣主言重了。無塵只是在等——
等真正的兇手，自己走出來。
……哈哈。那九霄，就陪先生慢慢地等。
（毒，不在酒中。在杯上……不。杯上也沒有。）
凌大俠……你也覺得是我下的毒嗎？
妳若要殺人，不會用毒。更不會用自己席上的杯子。
不是要害妳。是要所有人，都去追妳——和妳身上的劍譜。
哎呀呀，兩位還在這裡聊天？大事不好了！
龍淵閣已經發出江湖追殺令——燕姑娘的人頭，懸賞一萬兩！
是啊，我看了都心動……啊不是，我是說，我錢不二是講義氣的人！
這個消息，你賣給了幾個人？
先離開竹林。天亮以前，我們要找一個沒有人想得到的地方。
洛無塵……天下最聰明的人，偏偏總是最礙事的人。
你要等兇手走出來？好啊。
九霄就讓你看看，這個江湖，最後走出來的，會是誰。
蓮心小築。洛無塵回到池上的時候，有一個人，已經在橋頭等了很久。
慧明死了，可他不是中毒死的。有人要燕姑娘背這個罪名，要她帶著劍譜，一路逃，一路被人追。
逃得越遠，劍譜就越容易，落進那個人的手裡。
去找她。別讓她死，也別讓任何人知道，是我讓你去的。
天機將動，人心先亂。這一局……才剛開始。
夜深。龍淵閣中，只剩一具冰冷的屍首。
洛無塵啊洛無塵。你在等兇手？兇手，就在你們每一個人的身邊。
一杯毒酒，兩卷天機；千面之下，誰是真我？
欲知慧明死因，且看下回分解。
en: Three months ago, one sword under the moon sent the Blood Lotus Lord down into the sea of clouds.
But the storms of the martial world have never stopped for one man’s death.
Master Ling, the manual... must we really give it to the Three Teachings?
As long as you carry it, you will never have a day’s peace.
The council at the Dragon Abyss Pavilion will find it a home.
I only fear that even among the Three Teachings, someone wants it.
Nobody knows the news of the world like me;
pay me, and we’re the best of friends!
Qian Bu’er. What are you doing here?
Doing? Business, of course! You two are going to the Dragon Abyss Pavilion, aren’t you?
I advise you not to go... unless you give me ten taels of silver, and I tell you why.
Hee hee, generous! Because — those who go don’t always come back!
...He took the money to tell us that?
Qian Bu’er never sells news for nothing. Come.
The Dragon Abyss Pavilion. Yin Jiuxiao, first of the Confucians, has called the Three Teachings to decide the fate of the Heavenly Sword Manual.
In the deeps of the Dragon Abyss, storms lie hidden;
one light wave of the fan, and the nine provinces are settled.
Master Baihe, young Master Huiming — you have come far. Jiuxiao greets you.
My master Wuya is still in seclusion, and sent me in his place. I beg the Pavilion Master’s pardon.
Ha ha! I have been thinking about Brother Yin’s wine for three years!
Rest easy, Master. Tonight there is wine enough for all.
Young Master Ling, Miss Yan — a hard road. The manual... have you brought it?
I have. But first I want to hear what the Three Teachings mean to do with it.
The manual concerns all under heaven. Loose in the world, it will only draw more blood.
My thought is that the Pavilion keep it in trust, guarded by the three of us together.
Keep it in trust — and keep it, and keep it, until it’s yours. Ha ha ha!
One wild song, and heaven and earth grow narrow;
one blade can cut ten thousand years of grief.
A council of the Three Teachings? Talk all you like — the hardest fist decides!
Wei Wuyou. I do not recall the Pavilion sending you an invitation.
Wherever Wei Wuyou goes, he has never needed one.
Ling Yunxiao. They say you struck the Blood Lotus Lord down with one sword. I don’t believe it.
What you believe is no concern of mine.
Then let my blade ask your sword!
Drunk among the white clouds for three thousand years;
my sword comes from the west and asks heaven nothing.
Enough, enough! Drawing blades in the Dragon Abyss Pavilion — where would that leave Brother Yin’s honour?
Every one of us is here for the sake of the world. Why spoil the peace between us?
When the lotus opens, all under heaven is still;
between half a smile and the next, the game is won.
Luo Wuchen! You idle crane of the clouds — even you would come down from your mountain?
All the excitement under heaven is here. How could Wuchen miss it?
Master Luo honours the Pavilion with his presence. What is your view of the manual, sir?
No great view. The manual should belong to no one man — and to no one school.
Let each of the Three Teachings set its own seal on it, and lay it on the Peak of Ten Thousand Buddhas. No one can take it; no one need suspect another.
Amitabha. Master Luo’s words are exactly my master’s wish.
Good! I agree too. Brother Yin, what do you say?
...Master Luo has thought of everything. I am impressed.
Then let us swear it on wine. Come — everyone, drain your cups!
A cup of wine passed from Yan Feishuang’s table into Huiming’s hands.
I would take tea for wine... no. Today I will make an exception, and drink this one cup.
Poison! This cup... it came from Miss Yan’s table!
It wasn’t me! I didn’t even know —
Young Master Huiming spoke for the Peak. He died here — how do we answer to the Buddha Wuya? Seize her!
Luo Wuchen — you’d stand in my way?
Wuchen does not stop you. Only — when a man dies, one should first see how he died.
Young Master Ling, go after Miss Yan. Tonight she needs your sword more than you do.
Master Luo — are you shielding the murderer?
You say too much, Pavilion Master. Wuchen is only waiting —
waiting for the true murderer to show himself.
...Ha ha. Then I shall wait with you, sir, as long as it takes.
(The poison was not in the wine. On the cup, then... no. Not on the cup either.)
(This man did not die of poison at all.)
Master Ling... do you think I poisoned him too?
If you wanted to kill a man, you would not use poison. Still less a cup from your own table.
Then who? Who would do this to me?
Not to do it to you. To make everyone chase you — and the manual you carry.
Oh dear, oh dear — you two are still standing here chatting? Disaster!
The Dragon Abyss Pavilion has put out a warrant — ten thousand taels for Miss Yan’s head!
Yes — I was tempted myself... I mean, no! I, Qian Bu’er, am a man of honour!
How many people have you sold this news to?
...Three. No, four. You two had better run!
Out of the bamboo first. Before dawn we must find somewhere no one would think of.
Luo Wuchen... the cleverest man under heaven, and always the one most in the way.
You want to wait for the murderer to show himself? Very well.
I shall let you see who it is, in the end, that walks out of this world.
The Lotus Heart Retreat. When Luo Wuchen came back over the pond, someone had been waiting at the bridge a long time.
The lone goose flies by, and no one asks its name;
one stroke at the throat, and not a sound.
Huiming is dead, but not of poison. Someone wants Miss Yan to carry the blame — to run with the manual, hunted every step of the way.
The further she runs, the easier the manual falls into that someone’s hands.
Find her. Do not let her die — and let no one know that I sent you.
When heaven’s machinery stirs, men’s hearts are first to fall into disorder. This game... has only just begun.
Deep in the night. In the Pavilion, only a cold body remains.
Beneath a thousand faces, there is no true self;
one mirror shows every heart in the world.
That face of yours... I like it very much.
Luo Wuchen, Luo Wuchen. You are waiting for the murderer? The murderer is beside every one of you.
One cup of poison, two halves of the Stratagem; beneath a thousand faces, which is the true one?
How Huiming truly died, the next episode will tell.
